Class Scenario

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.domain.Scenario
public class Scenario extends Object
Represents a simulation scenario, including a trigger date, time period, and configured resources such as locomotives, cargos, and industry production settings.

    • applyAll

      public List<String> applyAll(Map map, List<Locomotive> locomotives)
      Applies all resources of this scenario to the provided map.

      Example: places each locomotive onto the map to start its route. Additional resource application (cargo distribution, industry setup) can be implemented here.

      Parameters:
      map - the Map context to which resources are applied
      locomotives - list of locomotives to place on the map
      Returns:
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if map or locomotives is null
